moments.title: On the 6th of September, we…
moments.body: On the 6th of September, we added each other on Snapchat, and for a long time I had no idea who you actually were.

moments.title: I first noticed you at a…
moments.body: I first noticed you at a school Christmas party — you were with my friend Matilde, and for a moment I wondered whether you really went to my school.

moments.title: Then, while preparing for a trip…
moments.body: Then, while preparing for a trip to Vienna with the school choir, I saw you at our final rehearsal and realised you'd be coming too. I felt a small spark of excitement, though I tried to stay calm about the whole thing.

moments.title: Over the trip, I found myself…
moments.body: Over the trip, I found myself glancing at you now and then, and sometimes our eyes would meet — I was too shy to hold the moment, so it always passed quickly.

moments.title: My curiosity only grew the first…
moments.body: My curiosity only grew the first time we really talked, you sitting on my bed while I sat in the chair beside you. I couldn't tell you now what we talked about, but I remember that neither of us could stop smiling.

moments.title: Also the kebab visit was such…
moments.body: Also the kebab visit was such a German story, haha.

moments.title: One evening after a choir rehearsal…
moments.body: One evening after a choir rehearsal, you showed up with cottage cheese pancakes, completely out of nowhere, and we spent a relaxed evening together at the Esplanade.

moments.title: Not long after, you joined me…
moments.body: Not long after, you joined me at the Street Food Point for a kebab, though you barely touched it.

moments.title: A few more dates followed that…
moments.body: A few more dates followed that I can't quite piece together now, but on one of them, at the cinema, we held hands for the first time, and you rested your head on my shoulder — the movie itself was forgettable, but I felt something spark in me, and somehow I just knew you were the one.

moments.title: When you went to Sweden for…
moments.body: When you went to Sweden for a week, you still came back with sweets for me. You are remarkably smart, always know what you want, and have the most beautiful smile.

moments.title: One day you invited me over…
moments.body: One day you invited me over, we talked for hours, and I finally kissed you by your windowsill — it was magical, and we kept kissing on the couch afterward. I felt like the happiest man alive.

moments.title: Not long after, we walked together…
moments.body: Not long after, we walked together through Klusais centrs and Ziedoņdārzs on a scorching hot day, and spent hours in the park doing absolutely nothing, which somehow felt like everything.

moments.title: I brought you a little flower…
moments.body: I brought you a little flower bracelet from Helsinki, and you crocheted me a small charm for my bag that still hangs there today.

moments.title: We spent a sunny day in…
moments.body: We spent a sunny day in Jūrmala, sunbathing and cuddling and doing next to nothing, and it made us both so happy.

moments.title: On my birthday, you gave me…
moments.body: On my birthday, you gave me a sweet card and a McQueen Lego set — such a thoughtful gesture — and we finished the day at the cinema and I asked you if you wanted to be sneaky together and you said yes.

moments.title: Before I left for Poland, we…
moments.body: Before I left for Poland, we baked brownies together, and they turned out wonderfully.

moments.title: We didn't see each other for…
moments.body: We didn't see each other for a week while I was away, and when I got back I brought you souvenirs — watching you open them, you looked as delighted as a child on Christmas morning, which made me just as happy.

moments.title: Soon after I returned, I got…
moments.body: Soon after I returned, I got my driver's license, and when we met up you were thrilled for me — it felt like a dream come true.

moments.title: After Marats' party, we went to…
moments.body: After Marats' party, we went to stay at your father's place, and those three days remain some of the best of my life: surrounded by nature, most of our time spent by the lake, simply enjoying being together.

moments.title: On the first night there, I…
moments.body: On the first night there, I told you I loved you, and you said you loved me too — from that moment on, we had said that we were in love with each other.

moments.title: Your father, his wife, and your…
moments.body: Your father, his wife, and your grandmother all loved the chocolate brownies I made, which felt like a small victory of its own.

moments.title: On our last morning there, we…
moments.body: On our last morning there, we went for a swim, and even with horseflies attacking us the whole time, you swam us safely back to shore.

moments.title: Afterward, you met my parents, and…
moments.body: Afterward, you met my parents, and they loved you instantly — I could see how happy and proud they were of me.

moments.title: I remember driving you to see…
moments.body: I remember driving you to see you on your way to work, just so we'd have a little more time together.

moments.title: I met your mom, and she…
moments.body: I met your mom, and she adored me right away.

moments.title: You helped me pack for my…
moments.body: You helped me pack for my flight and spent my last two nights with me, lying in the sun, drinking wine, and laughing.

moments.title: We had our last dinner in…
moments.body: We had our last dinner in Latvia together with my grandmother at 32th augusta restorāns, and the next morning Andzelina drove us to the airport. You cried, we hugged and kissed, and then it was time to say goodbye.

moments.title: Ever since, we've been FaceTiming every…
moments.body: Ever since, we've been FaceTiming every day, working together, and just talking and laughing, whether I'm cooking, you're working on your CAS project, or we're doing nothing at all.

moments.title: eighteen things
moments.body:
Now that you're turning eighteen, here are eighteen things I love about you:
1. I love your smile.
2. I love the way you look at me.
3. I love your greenish-grey eyes.
4. I love how you are with children.
5. I love that our hair is the same colour.
6. I love your sweetness.
7. I love how you always ask me questions.
8. I love how you trust me.
9. I love the way you cuddle me.
10. I love how you always say, "Viss būs labi, pookie."
11. I love the bond we share.
12. I love the cute way you express yourself.
13. I love how you dress.
14. I love your confidence in public — though you're still my little pookie when it's just us.
15. I love your presence.
16. I love how you see our future together.
17. I love the respect you have for me.
18. I love you.
